title: Medical Terminology: Roots, Prefixes, Suffixes

sources.name: Original definitions and decoding examples from standard medical terminology

description: For health-science learners: medical roots, prefixes, and suffixes paired with word-decoding practice and examples. Meanings depend on context; verify with current guidelines.
